approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical event promo for Lantern Night. A single continuous elegant shot of warm amber paper lanterns glowing gently in a dark park after nightfall, soft golden bokeh, deep midnight blue background, magical welcoming atmosphere. Lanterns sway subtly in a light breeze while the camera makes a very slow push forward. Keep the center visually uncluttered and dark for legible typography. Show a large, stable, crisp high-contrast cream-white event text overlay, centered and fully inside generous safe margins, visible throughout the entire video. Exact typography in three clear blocks: top heading 'Lantern Night'; very large middle line '14 November 2026'; large lower block 'Willow Park, Bristol'. Date and venue are the priority and must be easy to read on a phone. Use clean bold lettering, no extra words, no changing letters, no logos, no voiceover, no music, silent video.
